fields.Name: W1 -> S5.5
fields.Description: Gate G1.10 (phase 1, dataset W1, criterion S5.5): the W1-signal s42 snapshot's row manifest holds 16,776 rows, the content hash recomputed from the stored matrix matches (1 of 1), and a retrain from the snapshot and logged configuration reproduces the holdout metric within 1e-9. It fails when the retrain request's logged seed is changed (random_state 42 to 43), so the retrained holdout metric differs by more than 1e-9, or when the content hash is not verified.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The W1 snapshot manifest holds 16,776 rows, its content hash recomputes from the stored files, and a retrain from the snapshot reproduces the holdout metrics within 1e-9.
